created_at.description: Timestamp of when the Collection was created. Cannot be set by clients.

name.description: The name of the Collection. You can modify this value after the Collection is created.

notification_policy_slug.description:
The slug of the default notification policy for monitors in this collection.
This value is only required when the collection contains monitors and one
or more of those monitors don't explicitly reference a policy. This value does
not override the policy used when a monitor explicitly references a different
policy.

slug.description: The unique identifier of the Collection. If a `slug` isn't provided, one is generated based on the `name` field. You can't modify this field after the Collection is created.

team_slug.description: The slug of the team that the collection belongs to.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the Collection was last updated. Cannot be set by clients.
